notes: T14/§1.3-§14.6: member names sort by UTF-16 code units, full stop. The body has the supplementary-plane key U+1F600 (surrogate pair D83D DE00) and the BMP key U+E000; UTF-16 order puts U+1F600 first, while a code-point sort would put U+E000 first. The canonical bytes are produced by the independent tools/wcj.py, and the record is signed over them.
